## Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

### Essentials
- Passport
- Driver's license
- Travel insurance documents
- Plane ticket
- Hotel reservation
- Credit cards
- Debit card
- Cash

### Clothing
- 3-4 tops
- 2-3 bottoms
- 1 light jacket
- Swimwear
- Sunglasses
- Hats
- Socks
- Underwear

### Electronics
- Phone
- Laptop
- Portable charger
- Camera
- Power adapter
- Universal power adapter
- Waterproof phone case

### Toiletries
- Toothbrush
- Toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Shampoo
- Conditioner
- Body wash
- Razor
- Shaving cream
- Makeup
- Makeup remover
- Contact lenses
- Solution

### Miscellaneous
- Snorkeling gear
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Water bottle
- Collapsible umbrella
- Sunglasses case
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Reading material
- First aid kit
- Travel adapter
- Power strip

### Hawaii-specific
- Insect repellent
- Hawaiian shirt
- Aloha shirt
- Water shoes
- Sandals

### Notes
- Check the weather forecast before your trip
- Pack light
- Leave some space in your luggage for souvenirs
- Consider packing a small daypack for daily excursions
- Don't forget your sunscreen
- Bring a reusable water bottle

### Additional Tips
- Book your snorkeling tour in advance
- Consider renting a car for island-hopping
- Don't miss the luaus
- Learn some basic Hawaiian phrases
- Respect the local environment
